short_description: EU-based legal search platform looking for a production-grade RAG stack: large-scale embeddings index + cross-lingual reranker; strict residency and audit needs.
timeline: 2026-01-10: Intro call (AE Evelyn) - high level product fit, client emphasized GDPR + data residency.
2026-01-12: Deep-dive w/ SE (Liam) - discussed two-stage retrieval: dense embeddings -> cross-encoder rerank; target topK=100 -> rerank top10.
2026-01-20: Security questionnaire submitted; they requested KMS integration and retained audit logs for 7 years.
2026-02-05: Demo of hosted API + optimize suggestions; client asked about Dedicated for throughput predictability.
2026-02-21: Follow-up call (FF transcript ff_2026-02-21_0947) - POC scope agreed: 2 languages (EN, FR) initial; expand to DE, ES, PT, JA, ZH-CN after baseline.
2026-03-01: POC ingest started (test shard) - 1.8M docs ingested into test index; ingest rate target 1M docs/week in production.
2026-03-04: Evaluation sync - initial metrics show EN recall@10=0.89, FR recall@10=0.78; client requested per-language tuning plan.
Next: start 2-week dedicated POC, run per-language hyperparam sweep and reranker ablation by 2026-03-18.
detailed_requirements: Indexing scale: target 10-15M documents (legal briefs, contracts, verdicts); ~12M embeddings estimated.
Throughput: steady-state 200 qps for semantic search (peak bursts 600 qps), ingest 1M docs/week
Latency targets: q95 end-to-end search (embedding retrieval + rerank) <= 300ms for <50ms retrieval target for first stage, reranker budget <= 200ms for cross-encoder on top10 (prefer total <300ms).
Cost sensitivity: target average cost per query < $0.03 (including embedding lookup + reranker compute).
Multilingual coverage: initial focus EN, FR, DE, ES, PT, JA, ZH-CN, AR; require per-language recall/precision SLAs and ability to tune per-language ANN parameters.
Retrieval architecture preference: two-stage (sparse/ann -> embed dense approximate kNN top100 -> cross-encoder rerank top10 or mono-lingual rerankers where available).

Model preferences: client prefers open models for private deployment (LaBSE/XLM-R / sentence-transformers family) with option to evaluate cross-encoders (e.g., 'cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2') for reranking in Dedicated/Private deployments.
Data governance: must keep embeddings and reranker ops within customer VPC for Private deployment; no external model telemetry allowed.
Evaluation metrics: per-language recall@10, NDCG@10, precision@5; target thresholds - EN recall@10 >= 0.87, FR >= 0.82, DE >= 0.80, others negotiable.
Operational needs: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboards, rollouts for model swaps, and automatic fallback to lower-cost model for non-critical queries.
poc_notes: POC plan: 2 weeks on Dedicated in eu-central, ingest 2M doc subset, run baseline embeddings (all-mpnet-base-v2) -> ann index -> cross-encoder rerank comparison.
Success criteria: meet per-language recall thresholds and keep p95 latency under 350ms on dedicated pool; cost analysis report shows <$0.03/query at target throughput.
Milestones: week1 ingest + index + run baseline; week2 reranker experiments + cost/ops dashboard handoff.
Engineering ask: sample data schema, expected token distribution, and a small anonymized dataset of 100k docs by 2026-03-08.
sales_notes: Client quote: 'We cannot have model outputs or logs leave our VPC without encryption and explicit audit trails.'
AE notes: push Dedicated + Private combo; early win is Optimize recommendations to reduce per-query cost.
Pricing sensitivity: procurement is looking for a committed Dedicated PO with a fallback hosted API trial for burst handling.
Competition: already trialing Pinecone for ANN; main differentiator is Redwood's Dedicated with per-route dashboards + residency guarantees.
